USA's INCREDIBLE 20-Point Comeback in the AmeriCup Final!
Down by 20 points against Argentina in the 2017 FIBA AmeriCup Final, USA refused to give up and fought their way back into the game!
In a championship showdown packed with drama, USA erased a HUGE deficit and turned the final into an unforgettable battle for the AmeriCup title.
Relive the BEST moments from USA's incredible comeback against Argentina in the 2017 AmeriCup Final!
